enforceNodeGroupMinSize.description: Should ClusterAutoscaler scale up the node group to the configured min size if needed.

ignoreDaemonsetsUtilization.description: Whether DaemonSet pods will be ignored when calculating resource utilization for scaling down.

maxNodeProvisionTime.description: Maximum amount of time Cluster Autoscaler waits for a node to be provisioned.

maxNodesTotal.description: Maximum total number of nodes in the cluster, worker plus control plane.

metricsPort.description: metrics and liveness probe endpoints port

scaleDownDelayAfterAdd.description: Amount of time that Cluster Autoscaler waits after a scale-up operation and then resumes scale-down scans.

scaleDownDelayAfterDelete.description: Amount of time that Cluster Autoscaler waits after deleting a node and then resumes scale-down scans

scaleDownDelayAfterFailure.description: Amount of time that Cluster Autoscaler waits after a scale-down failure and then resumes scale-down scans.

scaleDownUnneededTime.description: Amount of time that Cluster Autoscaler must wait before scaling down an eligible node.

startupTaint.description: Specifies a taint to ignore in node templates when considering to scale a node group

clusterConfig.description: Details of the Workload cluster configuration

clusterNamespace.description: Management namespace where the workload cluster is hosted

paused.description: To pause the cluster autoscaler which will scale the replicas to 0 or 1

requests.description: The minimum guaranteed resources for the container.

cpu.description: measured in cores or millicores, e.g., 500m = 0.5 core

vksAddonManagement.description: To use the new mgmt secret name with cluster name prefix
